summary.headline: China's open GLM-5.3-Flash and Nvidia's record quarter
summary.body: Five small stories, mostly balancing out. China's Z.ai released GLM-5.3-Flash, a 320B open-weight model under an MIT licence; open models spread capability around, easing Power Concentration and helping the Libertarian and Egalitarian utopias. Nvidia's record $96.2 billion quarter added to Capability Velocity. The Guardian exposed an influence operation trying to seed AI chatbots with propaganda, raising Surveillance & Control and lifting 1984. Meta scrapping part of an 'AI-native' plan to cut teams was a small plus for Shared Prosperity. Sam Altman said OpenAI is '80%' to AGI while holding its biggest run until safety controls are ready. Horizon Balance: -4.90.
summary.movers_note: Egalitarian Utopia +0.1 from GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.08) and Meta's reversed cuts (+0.06); Libertarian Utopia +0.1 from GLM-5.3-Flash (+0.13); 1984 +0.1 from the chatbot propaganda story (+0.22).

events.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash, 320B open-weight multimodal model
events.summary: China's Z.ai released MIT-licensed GLM-5.3-Flash and confirmed it was behind the stealth 'Ox Alpha' model said to rival DeepSeek.

events.title: Nvidia posts record $96.2B quarterly revenue, up 106%
events.summary: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $96.22 billion, more than doubling year on year on AI data-centre demand.

events.title: Altman says OpenAI is '80%' to AGI while delaying its biggest training run
events.summary: In a TIME interview, Sam Altman described an 'AI research intern' and said OpenAI is about 80% of the way to AGI, while holding its largest run until new safety controls are ready.
events.reason: Lab-leader claim about own progress; words, not verified.

events.title: Meta scrapped 'AI-native' plan that would have cut teams by 60%
events.summary: Ars Technica reported Meta's AI-native workforce push produced more code but more incidents, and Meta cancelled some planned cuts.
events.reason: Evidence AI substitution under-delivered; cuts cancelled.

events.title: Influence operations try to seed AI chatbots with propaganda
events.summary: The Guardian exposed a fake Israeli-funded thinktank publishing 124 reports in nine days to be cited by AI assistants; OpenAI also banned a Russian influence cluster.
events.reason: State-linked information manipulation via AI; attempt, limited reach.
